profile.model: Backs companies that pair biology with computation and engineering, from AI-native drug discovery and design platforms to modality companies and diagnostics. It often leads or co-leads seed and Series A rounds and takes board seats. It invests from company creation through growth, and in January 2025 it added a separate Lilly-backed biotech ecosystem fund of up to $500M.
profile.summary: One of the first generalist VC firms to build a dedicated bio fund, starting with a $200M Bio Fund in the mid-2010s. Its portfolio includes insitro, Freenome, Scribe, Dyno and IDRx, which GSK bought for up to $1.15B.
